output.population: 284 TOF-MRA subjects, of which 127 are healthy controls and 157 are patients with brain aneurysm(s)
output.summary: Time-of-flight MR angiography with T1-weighted volumes from Lausanne University Hospital for brain aneurysm detection, with derivatives including skull-stripped volumes, manual aneurysm masks, bias-field-corrected images and registration quality metrics.
